title: OfficeChain
tagline: Manage your company as a social graph on a blockchain and Interoperate at Global Scale.
description: In building this system a social media platform frontend was created using react and html. Building out the backend with the LENS protocol didn’t happen because of time issues and some confusion about the process. I was hoping that Livepeer, Ceramic and some of the other sponsor systems could be integrated.
how_its_made: In building this system a social media platform frontend was created using react and html. Sponsor systems were not included because of time issues. I spent way too much time on the frontend.   I  read through the LFGrow documentation but found it confusing. Additionally, my keyboard is broken making  typing a painful process.
